title: TARSAssistantMessage
description: Canonical conversation-turn contract between a TARS client (laptop, iPhone, later ESP32) and the TARS backend's assistant surface. Covers both text and voice interaction modes. Shared by backend, frontend, and quality/integration tests.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking change and record a new ADR in DECISIONS.md.

conversation_id.description: Identifier grouping messages into a single conversation/session.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this message was created.

content.description: Text content of the message. For voice input, this is the transcribed text; for voice output, this is the text that was spoken.

input_mode.description: How the user supplied this message. Always 'text' for role='system'.

audio_ref.description: Opaque reference (e.g. local file path, storage key) to an associated audio clip, if any. Never a raw audio payload embedded in this message.

related_event_id.description: event_id of a trading-event (see trading-event.schema.json) this message concerns, if the message is about a specific alert/setup. Null otherwise.

intent.description: Optional coarse intent classification for the message (e.g. 'show_active_setups', 'explain_invalidation', 'attention_summary'). Null when not classified.

providers.description: Which provider adapters produced/consumed this message, for debugging and provider-swap verification. All fields null when not applicable (e.g. a text-only, non-voice message).

stt.description: SpeechToTextProvider adapter name used to produce this message's content, if input_mode='voice'.

assistant.description: AssistantProvider adapter name used to produce this message, if role='assistant'.

tts.description: TextToSpeechProvider adapter name used to render this message's audio, if audio_ref is set on an assistant message.

error.description: Non-null when this message represents a provider/pipeline error surfaced to the user (e.g. STT failure), describing what went wrong.
